# briizOS AI Data Catalog

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-tool-catalog.mjs. Edit data-catalog.js, not this file. -->

This document mirrors `electron/agent/data-catalog.js`, the source of truth for data the in-process agent may read. Reads are local, read-only, and logged as `agent.data`. Values remain stored once; panels and calendar placements are contextual appearances.

The dedicated task, Forest, organizer, placement, and schedule tools remain optimized for common work. `briizos_query_data` provides bounded access to these additional domains: `journals`, `notefall_posts`, `canvases`, `files`, `conversations`, `memory`, `recorder_sessions`, `automation_runs`, `media`, `briiztorm`, `workspace`, `settings`, `logs`, `system_status`.

## Tasks

- Key: `tasks`
- Category: `work`
- Read tools: `briizos_list_tasks`, `briizos_get_task`

Tasks from the Tasks Panel, each with optional subtasks ("steps"/deck items). A task with subtasks renders as a deck.

Fields:
- id, title, description
- status: pending | created | running | in_progress | active | waiting | deferred | completed | cancelled | blocked
- priority: low | normal | medium | high | urgent
- due_at (ISO timestamp or null)
- forest_project_id (backlink to a Forest project, or null)
- subtasks: [{ id, title, status, position }]
- taskLog, created_at, updated_at, revision
Relationships:
- forest_project_id → forest_projects.id
- placements.ref_id → tasks.id
Filters and detail controls:
- status
- priority
- project_id
- forest_project_id
- limit

## Projects (islands)

- Key: `forest_projects`
- Category: `work`
- Read tools: `briizos_list_projects`, `briizos_get_project`

The user's real projects, shown as islands on desks in the Islands app. These are the ONLY "projects" in briizOS.

Fields:
- id, name, tags
- stage (current), stages (the island's stage list), status (where it stands), field, folder (project folder on disk)
- cards: [{ kind, title }] (terminal, webview, thoughts, media, agent, docs, goals, planning, ship, monetize)
- milestones: [{ name, completed }] (dated points on the islands journal calendar)
- files: attached file names/paths
- detail only: about (answers to What is it? / What makes it unique? / 3 Best Features), chapter, recentJournal
- optional scoring fields when set: deadline (YYYY-MM-DD), importance (1-10), size (hours), relevance
- revision
Relationships:
- tasks.forest_project_id → forest_projects.id
- files belong to exactly one Forest project appearance
Filters and detail controls:
- limit; use project_id with briizos_get_project for detail

## Scheduled task sessions

- Key: `placements`
- Category: `time`
- Read tools: `briizos_list_placements`, `briizos_get_schedule`

Thin Calendar appearances of Tasks Panel tasks. The task value is joined live; recurring rows expand into occurrences at query time.

Fields:
- id, ref_id (task id), occurrence_date
- start_minute, duration_minutes, recurrence
- session_completed (this occurrence happened)
- task: live task title, status, priority, project backlink
Relationships:
- ref_id → tasks.id; a task can have many placements
Filters and detail controls:
- date_from, date_to, ref_id, limit

## Calendar events

- Key: `organizer_events`
- Category: `time`
- Read tools: `briizos_query_organizer`, `briizos_get_schedule`, `findScheduleConflicts`

Standalone calendar items (meetings, appointments). Scheduled tasks are NOT events — they are tasks appearing on the calendar.

Fields:
- id, title, body, status, tags
- scheduled_start_at / scheduled_end_at (ISO timestamps)
- due_at, duration_seconds
- recurrence (rule object or null)
- created_at, updated_at, revision
Relationships:
- Calendar is a union view of organizer_events + placements
Filters and detail controls:
- type=event, date_from, date_to, limit

## Notes

- Key: `organizer_notes`
- Category: `knowledge`
- Read tools: `briizos_search_notes`, `briizos_query_organizer`

Note panels (title + body), searchable by content.

Fields:
- id, title, body, status, tags
- created_at, updated_at, revision
Relationships:
- A sticky note is an organizer note with workspace appearance metadata
Filters and detail controls:
- query text with briizos_search_notes; type=note with briizos_query_organizer

## Timers

- Key: `timers`
- Category: `time`
- Read tools: `briizos_query_organizer`

Timer items from the organizer domain.

Fields:
- id, title, body, status, duration_seconds, tags
- created_at, updated_at, revision
Relationships:
- Stored as organizer items with type=timer
Filters and detail controls:
- type=timer, date_from, date_to, limit

## Journals and folios

- Key: `journals`
- Category: `knowledge`
- Read tools: `briizos_query_data`

Journal notebooks and their ordered folios. Folios are typed pages whose content is structured JSON.

Fields:
- journal: id, title, tags, cover, page, folioCount
- folio: id, journalId, type, title, content, position
- createdAt, updatedAt, revision
Relationships:
- folios.journalId → journals.id
- Notefall posts may link to a journal
Filters and detail controls:
- domain=journals, id (journal), query, include_content, limit

## Notefall posts

- Key: `notefall_posts`
- Category: `knowledge`
- Read tools: `briizos_query_data`

Quick captures and recorder-derived posts, including notes, tags, media, screenshots, source, and session timing.

Fields:
- id, body, notes, tags, statusDot
- authorType, sourceApp, captureMode
- journalId, media, screenshots, sessionStart, sessionEnd
- createdAt, updatedAt, revision
Relationships:
- journalId → journals.id
- attachments → files.id
Filters and detail controls:
- domain=notefall_posts, id, parent_id (journal), query, include_content, limit

## Canvases

- Key: `canvases`
- Category: `creation`
- Read tools: `briizos_query_data`

Saved mini-apps and HTML documents, including their source, render engine, form factor, and panel settings.

Fields:
- id, title, size, source, url
- renderEngine, formFactor, panelSettings
- html (detail only), createdAt, updatedAt, revision
Relationships:
- Workspace panels can point to canvases
Filters and detail controls:
- domain=canvases, id, query, include_content, limit

## Known files

- Key: `files`
- Category: `knowledge`
- Read tools: `briizos_query_data`, `read_file`

Files indexed by briizOS through Forest, Media, Notefall attachments, or chat selection. This is metadata; use read_file for contents.

Fields:
- id, path, display_name, kind, size, modified_at, availability
- selected, in_media_queue, forest_project_count
- created_at, updated_at, revision
Relationships:
- Referenced by Forest files, Notefall attachments, Media queue items, and selected chat files
Filters and detail controls:
- domain=files, id, query, kind, status (availability), limit

## Conversation history

- Key: `conversations`
- Category: `history`
- Read tools: `briizos_query_data`

Stored chat, planner, prioritizer, and deck threads with ordered user, assistant, system, and tool messages.

Fields:
- thread: id, kind, title, model_profile_id, status
- message: id, sequence, role, content, isError, timestamp
- created_at, updated_at, revision
Relationships:
- messages.threadId → threads.id
- planner/prioritize/deck interactions use distinct thread kinds
Filters and detail controls:
- domain=conversations, id (thread), query, kind, status, include_content, limit

## Agent memory

- Key: `memory`
- Category: `history`
- Read tools: `briizos_query_data`

The structured long-term profile and individual memory facts used to carry user context between conversations.

Fields:
- workContext, personalContext, topOfMind
- recentMonths, earlierContext, longTermBackground, agentContext
- facts: id, content, category, confidence, source, timestamps
Relationships:
- facts may cite a source conversation thread
Filters and detail controls:
- domain=memory, id (agent key), query, include_content, limit

## Recorder sessions

- Key: `recorder_sessions`
- Category: `history`
- Read tools: `briizos_query_data`

Named activity-recording sessions and their ordered timestamped events.

Fields:
- id, name, start_time, end_time, revision
- events: id, type, timestamp, data
Relationships:
- Recorder-derived captures may also appear in Notefall
Filters and detail controls:
- domain=recorder_sessions, id, query, include_content, limit

## Automation runs

- Key: `automation_runs`
- Category: `activity`
- Read tools: `briizos_query_data`

Accepted commands and their execution runs, progress, result or error, linked task/thread, and ordered events.

Fields:
- id, instruction, source, status, progressCurrent/progressTotal
- taskId, threadId, resultSummary, errorCode/errorMessage
- events, startedAt, finishedAt, createdAt, updatedAt, revision
Relationships:
- taskId → tasks.id
- threadId → conversations.id
Filters and detail controls:
- domain=automation_runs, id, query, status, include_content, limit

## Media queue and playback state

- Key: `media`
- Category: `activity`
- Read tools: `briizos_query_data`

The ordered local media queue plus the current item, playback position, volume, repeat, and shuffle state.

Fields:
- tracks: queue_id, file_id, path, display_name, kind, size, availability
- currentItemId, currentTime, volume, isMuted, repeatMode, shuffle, panelState, revision
Relationships:
- tracks reference files.id
Filters and detail controls:
- domain=media, id (file or queue item), query, kind, limit

## briiZtorm state

- Key: `briiztorm`
- Category: `creation`
- Read tools: `briizos_query_data`

The 3D project-space state: projects, visual theme, flight settings, and saved flight presets.

Fields:
- projects
- theme
- flightSettings
- flightPresets
Relationships:
- This is a separate visual project representation, not the canonical Forest project domain
Filters and detail controls:
- domain=briiztorm, query, include_content, limit

## Workspace layout

- Key: `workspace`
- Category: `configuration`
- Read tools: `briizos_query_data`

The current columns, visible/hidden panels, panel sizing, links, and workspace-level layout state.

Fields:
- layout version, columns, hiddenPanels, workspace
- panels: id, feature_key, linked organizer/canvas, column, position, size, visible, view_mode
- revision, updatedAt
Relationships:
- Panels may link to organizer notes/events or canvases; layout is appearance state, never a copy of content
Filters and detail controls:
- domain=workspace, id (panel), kind (feature), status (visible|hidden), limit

## App and model settings

- Key: `settings`
- Category: `configuration`
- Read tools: `briizos_query_data`

Non-secret user preferences, enabled skills, model profiles, permission policy, and provider-key availability booleans.

Fields:
- setting keys and values (sensitive-looking keys recursively redacted)
- model profile: name, provider, model, capabilities, default
- provider key status: configured true/false only; key values are never readable
Relationships:
- threads may reference a model profile
Filters and detail controls:
- domain=settings, query, include_content, limit

## Log Panel entries

- Key: `logs`
- Category: `activity`
- Read tools: `briizos_query_data`

The inspectable audit trail for app, AI, calendar, task, sync, and tool activity.

Fields:
- id, type, source, category, message, data, level
- threadId, sessionId, taskId, timestamp
Relationships:
- Entries may link to a conversation, recorder session, or task
Filters and detail controls:
- domain=logs, id, query, kind (category), status (level), parent_id (thread), date_from, date_to, limit

## Local data status

- Key: `system_status`
- Category: `configuration`
- Read tools: `briizos_query_data`

Database generation/schema status, per-domain revisions, and domains waiting for continuity sync.

Fields:
- ready, storageGeneration, schemaVersion
- domain revisions and updated_at
- pending sync domains with revision/status metadata
Relationships:
- Describes freshness and sync state; it does not expose sync payloads or device identity
Filters and detail controls:
- domain=system_status

| Modality | Injected objects |
|---|---|
| `chat` | `tasks`, `forest_projects`, `placements`, `organizer_events`, `organizer_notes`, `timers`, `journals`, `notefall_posts`, `canvases`, `files`, `conversations`, `memory`, `recorder_sessions`, `automation_runs`, `media`, `briiztorm`, `workspace`, `settings`, `logs`, `system_status` |
| `plan` | `tasks`, `forest_projects`, `organizer_events`, `placements`, `organizer_notes`, `timers`, `journals`, `notefall_posts`, `conversations`, `automation_runs`, `recorder_sessions` |
| `planner` | `organizer_events`, `placements`, `tasks`, `forest_projects` |
| `prioritize` | `forest_projects`, `tasks` |
| `research` | `organizer_notes`, `journals`, `notefall_posts`, `canvases`, `forest_projects`, `files`, `conversations` |
| `code` | `forest_projects`, `files`, `canvases`, `conversations`, `automation_runs`, `logs`, `system_status` |
| `report` | `tasks`, `forest_projects`, `organizer_events`, `placements`, `journals`, `notefall_posts`, `conversations`, `automation_runs`, `recorder_sessions`, `logs` |

## Unavailable by design

- `secrets`: Encrypted provider credentials are never exposed to agent read tools.
- `sync_internals`: Raw outbox payloads, remote cursors, and shared-text mirrors remain service-internal.
- `agent_checkpoints`: LangGraph checkpoints and checkpoint writes are execution internals, not user information.
- `operation_receipts`: Idempotency receipts and request hashes remain execution internals.
- `identity_metadata`: Device identity and raw app metadata are not included in model context.
